status_note: This repository includes local composition commands and a documentary runtime qualification plan. Private replay tools are not distributed. No runtime qualification is performed by repository reorganization. This historical 0.3.0 plan has English expectations for the 0.3.1 source; it has not been replayed for either version in this library.
preconditions: The corrected AGENT-1049 Brain image is published by its GitLab pipeline and digest-pinned in the consumer Agent. No local docker build or push.
Memory 1.0.16 and brain-sidecar images are digest-pinned as for 0.2.0; take values from the consumer, not this plan.
An isolated One is prepared by the owning session through the canonical sandbox procedure; this library has no dev-stack.sh and its CI starts no runtime.
Two distinct integration_test Agents A and B using filesystem storage, each with dedicated Memory and Brain sidecars and volumes.
A qualification consumer with 0.2.0 copies updated using the selected migration procedure in the README, then composed with the target Module.
Replays write to both test Agents: do not use a memory containing business data.
decisions_needed: Choose the 0.2.0 → 0.3.0 consumer upgrade procedure: compose.py refuses different files unless explicitly updated; review the consumer change and use --update where authorized.
Confirm the exact concise brain.keyword response shape (URI field, passage ID, score and excerpt) with AGENT-1049 before removing the detailed fallback.
An image ignoring response_format must fail; a silent empty result blocks qualification.
